# Hash

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Hashes the provided input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
hash(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, type: <#Enumeration (WFHashType)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
hash(input: ShortcutInput, type: SHA256)
~~~~
